nodes.label: Export: Markdown, PDF, HTML (handwriting as images)
Local full-text search index on each client
nodes.rationale: Server cannot search encrypted content, so the instant full-text index lives on each client.

nodes.label: Unresolved [[Title]] text rendered as link
nodes.rationale: Agents write [[Title]] for notes that may not exist yet; the editor renders it as a link and lets the app open or offer to create the note.

nodes.label: D-16 Import deferred
nodes.rationale: Import not now; maybe later from Obsidian/Notesnook.

nodes.label: Note style and cover (setNoteStyle, setNoteCover, setNoteBackdrop)
agentEdit mark
nodes.rationale: Agent-written text keeps the agentEdit mark until a human accepts; accepting just removes the mark and is a normal undoable, synced edit. Human text typed inside/next to it does not inherit the mark.

nodes.label: Resilience to foreign invalid content
nodes.rationale: y-prosemirror drops schema-invalid elements by default; on 2026-10-26 this lost code blocks in an agent note.

nodes.label: formatVersion newer than supported opens read-only
Inline $…$ formula rendering
nodes.rationale: Contract has only mathBlock, but agents and users write $…$ inline; rendered without changing the document.

nodes.label: Multiple title nodes repair
nodes.rationale: Keeps first non-empty title, removes empty extras, demotes non-empty extras to paragraphs with the same blockId; idempotent, never touches docs without a title.

nodes.label: Unknown/invalid nodes preserved (Unsupported block placeholder)
nodes.rationale: Opening a note never writes to the document; verified by a round-trip test on an agent-built note.

nodes.label: Agent edits banner (Accept all / View history)
"Created by agent" banner with Got it
Quiet agent-edit highlight (green left-margin bar)
nodes.rationale: Text itself is not colored or underlined, per the premium quiet-design principle.

nodes.label: D-10 Agent edits review and acceptance
D-45 Note created entirely by agent
nodes.rationale: A fully agent-created note is not highlighted line by line; a calm banner is shown instead.

nodes.label: onLinkRequest / setLink(_:)
nodes.rationale: The editor does not read the clipboard itself to avoid the system 'Paste' permission prompt.

nodes.label: Single tap on links/task circles/date chips (iOS)
nodes.rationale: Tapping active elements does not place the cursor or raise the keyboard; each is a separate accessibility element.

nodes.label: Task date chips (scheduled/deadline) and context menu
D-51 Notes-only mode (taskDatesEnabled)
nodes.rationale: When off, task dates show as quiet labels, no reschedule menu; dates remain unchanged in the document.

nodes.label: Full layout on open (up to 40,000 chars)
nodes.rationale: Full layout on open keeps document height from changing under the finger.

nodes.label: No auto-scroll while finger is on text
defaultTitle / commitDefaultTitleIfNeeded()
nodes.rationale: Empty title is filled with the app's default title only if the note has text; the 'empty note is not saved' rule lives in the app.

nodes.label: D-01 Markdown only as export/agent format
nodes.rationale: Own block-tree storage in CRDT; Markdown is used only for export and as the format for agents.

nodes.label: Editor content blocks (headings, lists, checklists, quotes, callouts, tables, code, formulas, attachments, drawing blocks)
Demoted title paragraph repair (empty title + older blockId paragraph)
nodes.rationale: Empty-document race can demote the original title into a paragraph; deterministic repair on open and after remote changes moves its text (marks, stroke anchors) back into title without creating anything.

nodes.label: Accepting agent edit is an ordinary undoable, synced edit
Human-typed text near agent edit does not inherit agentEdit

hyperedges.label: Agent edit review and acceptance flow
iOS scroll stability under the finger
